title: Writer Technology Infinite Canvas Lsp
description: Create a new writer technology: full-blown text editor on infinite canvas (Vello/WebGPU via infinite/cavas), real JSON-RPC LSP client/server in Web Worker, writer playground with jack fixture, jack language server (lint/format/hover/completion), integrate WriterCanvas into trinity/jack shell replacing CodeEditor.
summary: Semantic token-wise selection: selectableSpansForJack builds atomic lexer spans plus varLabel and propertyAccess composites (a1, a1:Piece, name, a1.name). WASM normalizes selection/drag/edit to token boundaries and expands partial composite overlaps. All tokens are atomic for caret/delete/arrows. Double-click selects semantic span at pointer; F2 opens inline rename input. Spans synced from react to WASM each edit.
